title: Duke's music for the Ethel Waters show and the Follies
summary: Duke wrote the full score for Ethel Waters's Cotton Club show, which Juan extracted, but nothing for the Ziegfeld Follies.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well, he was not much of a musician, they thought, to know how to arrange things, like for the Carnegie Hall concert and the Ziegfeld Follies. But he in the Cotton Club, he wrote the Ethel Waters Show -- what's their name, oh I don't know, the time Ethel Waters opened at the Cotton Club, he put the music for the whole show.
Did he write special music for that show?
Sure. He had to. Sure, especially for her. His own music.
And at the Cotton Club, he wrote new music for those shows, too?
Not for all the shows; sometimes they used to have somebody else. But for that particular show, with Ethel Waters, he wrote the music, and I used to do all the extractions on them.
And for the Ziegfeld Follies, did he write the music for that, too?
No, I'm sorry; he did nothing for the Ziegfeld Follies, no.
